title: Level descriptors: 6-mark analyse and 9-mark discuss questions
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y10 lesson 48 (Level descriptors for 6- and 9-mark questions (teacher-written, pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 48. Use these to plan, peer-mark and improve answers. Each chain needs context from the case.

head: Level
Marks
What the answer does
rows: Knowledge of the topic; a point with little development or context.
Points applied to the case with some development.
Two points, each developed into a full chain (point, because, so, which means) and linked to the case and the question.

head: Level
Marks
What the answer does
rows: Knowledge of the topic; points are listed or generic, with little or no link to the case.
Points are applied to the case and developed with chains (because, so, which means). Some balance, but the judgement is missing or not supported.
Both sides are developed in context; a clear decision weighs them, gives the key reason and says what it depends on.

bullets: The owner is considering zero-hours contracts or permanent part-time staff
